notice: Synthetic on-policy simulation with generated counterfactual outcomes; not historical off-policy evaluation, real listener validation, calibration, or proof of policy improvement.

design.reward: 0.75 * usefulness + 0.25 * (label - frozenRemovalProbability)^2; correction is zero for heuristic; SKIP has null reward
design.initialState: zero labels; each policy learns only from its own completed selected reviews
design.holdout: Independent seeded stream, never selectable; observed selected library labels are training-only
design.learningCurve: Evaluate every 20 exposures and at final budget; no checkpoint affects training or selection
design.baselineC1: Recompute PreferenceModel.rank(limit=1) after each exposure; first recommendation in an adaptive C1 queue
design.baselineRandom: Uniform over all remaining candidates; no artist, exploration-cap, or obvious-keep restriction
design.adaptivePolicies: epsilon-greedy and LinUCB use learned review reward; 25% prefix exploration cap, 3-exposure artist window, obvious-keep threshold 0.1
design.uncertainty: C1 predictive entropy, ridge leverage uncertainty and design information gain are distinct diagnostics
design.regret: Not reported: adaptive classifier-dependent reward and changing contexts do not define stationary global regret. No theoretical LinUCB regret bound is claimed.
design.aggregation: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation across distinct world seeds; null std for n<2; no significance or confidence-interval claim
design.selectionBias: No IPS/DR estimator or unsupported cross-policy feedback replay. Potential outcomes exist for all actions only because this is a declared synthetic environment.
